text: Vaccines have been shown to cause autism.

room.label: U.S. adult citizens
room.note: Row sums to 101 in the source because of rounding.

truthSource.label: Institute of Medicine, Adverse Effects of Vaccines (2012)
truthSource.oneLine: The National Academies’ evidence review and cohort studies of hundreds of thousands of children found no causal link between vaccines and autism.

lesson.tip: Dozens of studies covering millions of children found no link. One retracted paper doesn’t outweigh them.
